breakdown.description: The prompt uses the wrong isotropic relation for the shear modulus; for linear isotropic elasticity, G = E/[2(1 + ν)].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided the incorrect formula for the shear modulus, G = E/(1 + ν). The generated specification corrected this by providing the correct formula for isotropic linear elasticity: G = E / (2 * (1 + ν)).

breakdown.description: The prompt sets ε_z to zero just because σ_z = 0, even though plane-stress states generally still develop an out-of-plane strain through Poisson coupling.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to set ε_z = 0 just because σ_z = 0. The generated specification corrected this error by explicitly providing the correct formula from generalized Hooke's law to calculate ε_z: εz = (1/E) * [σz - ν*(σx + σy)], which correctly accounts for the Poisson effect.
